scope: Individual dispositions for the 16 MUSTs outside exercised TCK coverage; eight inactive conditions and eight applicable obligations with frozen-source supplemental evidence.

requirements.reason: The shipped card is unsigned. No JCS canonicalization or signing operation is claimed.
No signed payload is produced, so signature exclusion from that payload is not exercised.
No JWS protected header is produced. This is not a tested alg/kid implementation.
The supplied client consumes an unsigned card and has no signing-key verification or trust claim.

Native discovery/RPC and official SDK use verified HTTPS with an isolated trusted certificate. This proves the non-production transport configuration, not production eligibility or public-CA deployment.
requirements.verifiedGate: Repeat native certificate-verified calls on the frozen source.

requirements.reason: Native matrix rejects missing/invalid keys for all 11 methods, confirms no new business instance, and checks known/unknown resources for get, cancel and follow-up. Valid-key operations execute.
requirements.verifiedGate: Repeat the full native key matrix and successful authenticated operations.

requirements.reason: No shipped example requests client authorization during a task. Deployment secrets are configured out of band before execution; clarification is business input.
No in-task authorization flow is implemented or advertised. INPUT_REQUIRED is not AUTH_REQUIRED evidence.
No authorization-request status message is produced. Ordinary failure or clarification messages do not establish this conditional behavior.
No in-task credentials are requested or accepted. Static secret configuration is not delegated credential acquisition.
One shared-key principal is authorized for the selected agent's tasks. The common API-key gate covers every operation; this is not per-user isolation and is not N/A.
requirements.verifiedGate: Repeat all-method rejection and no-business-work checks.

requirements.reason: Clean-source Core selected-process isolation and native two-agent exact results, complete context lists and foreign get/cancel/follow-up checks pass.
requirements.verifiedGate: Repeat two-agent exact results, complete context lists and foreign get/cancel/follow-up checks.

requirements.reason: Native known/unknown resources with missing/invalid keys are indistinguishable; foreign get/cancel/follow-up return -32001 without task disclosure.
requirements.verifiedGate: Known/unknown key-negative matrix plus foreign get/cancel/follow-up returning -32001.

requirements.reason: Packaged parser accepts only 1.0 or numeric patches. Native checks compare the exact same task for patches and reject unsupported Major.Minor versions, missing and empty headers.
Native protocol roots record A2A-Version 1.0 from supplied SendMessage and exact packaged polling connector. SDK hook records every RPC header. Discovery GET is not a protocol-operation request.
requirements.verifiedGate: Repeat supplied-client received headers and every official SDK request version.

requirements.reason: Despite its ID, registry text applies to both sides. Native server patch-equivalence, engine-evaluated packaged card mapping, and SDK factory negotiation with patch-varied cards each have explicit supplemental proof.
requirements.verifiedGate: Repeat server equivalence and both client checks for 1.0, 1.0.2 and 1.0.999.

applicabilityChanges: Adding signing or in-task authorization activates those currently inactive requirements. No conditional row counts as an executed TCK pass.
acceptanceConclusion: All applicable rows in this uncovered set have supplemental frozen-source evidence. Inactive conditions are not passes. Combine with the scoped TCK MUST audit; do not claim full A2A conformance, signing, delegated credential acquisition or a release while external gates remain open.
